measurement: line-count ratchet: a measured runtime file may never exceed its recorded value; `ceiling` is the absolute bound that only an explicitly recorded decision may raise
history: v53.96/P895 (commit 6fd5289b, 2026-08-10) introduced fixed caps on three files. Those caps were never read from this file — the numbers were hardcoded in scripts/ci-decomp-hotspot-check.mjs, so the declaration and the enforcement could silently disagree. They also covered only 3 of 7 runtime files, so accretion escaped sideways into aio-ui/aio-chat/aio-tests, and at js/aio-core.js the cap sat 1 line above the file — a wall that blocked a one-line correctness fix instead of a ratchet.
facadePolicy: bounded compatibility facade only; no permanent duplicate primary writer
codeMapRescan: required after any change greater than 500 lines
